title: Sensitive information types: how does Purview recognise sensitive data?
summary: The portal copying instructions omit an exception that requires administrators to use PowerShell instead: SITs with 10 text processors or restricted text processors cannot be copied directly in the UI. The commands, licensing requirements and numerical limits are supported, but the claimed effect on every referencing rule and the planned built-in improvement remain unconfirmed.
